Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this exciting encounter. Bangladesh have done their part and now their fate relies on the result of tomorrow's game between Australia and England at Edgbaston. Do join us for that crunch game at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Kane Williamson says that he thought it was a scrappy total on this wicket. Feels the boys bowled well with the new ball. He admits they were a long way away from a perfect performance today. He reckons they were 20 to 25 runs short. Adds that something around 285-290 would have been a match-winning total. Credits Bangladesh for their performance and congratulates them.

Mashrafe Mortaza says that it's a great feeling and in both wins here in Cardiff (one against Australia in 2005), he was present. He is very satisfied with the overall performance of his team. Adds that his bowlers bowled really well and hit the right areas. Praises Mosaddek Hossain for bowling three crucial overs and informs that the idea was to introduce him when there were two left-handers in the middle. He is all praise for Mahmudullah and Shakib Al Hasan and hopes that they continue in the same way. Admits that it was a difficult game but they had the confidence after beating New Zealand in their last meeting.

Man of the Match, Shakib Al Hasan says that there wasn't much talk in the middle and they just wanted to bat 40 overs and see where they go. Feels that the ball was swinging early and they wanted to survive and hit the bad balls. Adds that it's a big thing to win a game in an ICC tournament and hopes to move forward from here.

Under immense pressure, the pair of Shakib Al Hasan and Mahmudullah got together. The going was not easy at the start but they weathered the storm and then went on to raise a record 224-run stand. Both the batsmen scored a century each and completely turned the game on its head. Nothing went right for New Zealand after the initial spell and they find themselves out of the tournament. They did try hard in the middle overs but failed to get the decisive breakthrough. Mitchell Santner put brakes on the scoring rate from one end but there wasn't enough pressure built from the other side.

Coming to the chase, it was an outstanding beginning by New Zealand. Tim Southee was on fire and removed Bangladesh's top three batsmen in a jiffy. Adam Milne removed Mushfiqur Rahim in the 12th over to further push the Asian team on the back foot. But what happened after that was simply amazing.

What a game of cricket we have just witnessed! Sensational Bangladesh have outclassed the Kiwis to stay alive in the tournament. A little lap of honour by the Bangladeshi players. They want to thank all their supporters who have come out in numbers to back them. Great moment for the Bangla Tigers. 12 years back they tasted same type of success when they toppled Australia at this very venue.

FOUR! Bangladesh win by 5 wickets! Milne bowls it sharp and quick outside off, Mosaddek tries to drive but edges it down to third man for a boundary. New Zealand are knocked out of the Champions Trophy. The crowd is going mad. Mashrafe Mortaza stands in the dressing room and roars in delight. The Bangladesh players are smiling and exchanging pleasantries in the middle. What a historic win for them!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Hossain taps it down to gully.

FOUR! Hundred number 3 for Mahmudullah in ODIs, what a superlative knock by him. Boult digs in a short ball around leg and Mahmudullah muscles it over backward square leg. It goes on one bounce to the fence. He goes down on his knees, kisses the ground and celebrates his century. What a player!
Mahmudullah two away from his century.
Width on offer outside off, Mosaddek runs it down past second slip for a run. 6 needed from 19 balls.
Full toss outside off, Hossain opens the face of the bat and pushes it past the point fielder for a couple of runs.
Mosaddek Hossain is the new batsman. Two slips in place for him.

OUT! Anticlimax! Boult hurls in a full length delivery, angling in the line of the stumps, Shakib gets carried away and goes after it with the full swing of his bat. Fails to connect and finds his stumps shattered. End of a superb knock and he departs without finishing the job. 9 needed from 21 balls.
FOUR! He has hammered it! Boult is on the shorter side, around off, Shakib jumps out, makes room and packs a punch through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Terrific batting! Boult follows the batsman down the leg side with a length ball, Shakib checks his drive and sends it packing down the ground for a boundary at long on.
Fuller on off, driven to mid off for a sharp single as the fielder failed to score a direct hit at the bowler's end.
7th ODI hundred for Shakib Al Hasan.

SIX! Wow, he is a superstar of Bangladesh cricket and he has batted like a superstar today! Milne bangs in a short ball, Shakib top edges his pull shot into the stand at fine leg for a biggie to bring up his hundred. He raises his bat. The crowd is making a lot of noise. What a knock by him!
Fuller and straighter, Mahmudullah tries to nudge it but misses. It goes off his pads to fine leg and they take a leg bye.
Short and wide outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it straight to backward point.
A cover-point comes in.
Sharp single. On a length and outside off, Shakib pushes it to cover-point and rushes to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end. Moves to 99!
A hint of reverse there, full and angling in, Shakib pushes it back.
Adam Milne is brought back into the attack. He comes running in but pulls out at the last moment. Plenty of boos from the crowd.
Back of a length delivery on off, a short-arm jab by Shakib in front of square leg for a run. Both batsmen on 98. 26 needed from 30 balls.
Shortish and wide outside off, Shakib swishes and misses.
Digs in a short ball, Shakib tries to hook but misses.
FOUR! Shot! Great presence of mind shown by Shakib. He knows the mid off is in place and hence makes room to smash a length ball over that region. Connection is top class and it's a boundary.
Mahmudullah plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Wide! Boult runs in from around the wicket and angles a length ball down the leg side, Mahmudullah tries to flick but misses.
200-run stand between Shakib Al Hasan and Mahmudullah!
Shortish around middle, pulled through square leg for a single. Brilliant partnership, this. They have put Bangladesh on the brink of a win here.
Trent Boult is back on. 34 needed from 36 balls.
Too full and angling into the batsman from around the wicket, Shakib pushes it straight to mid on and takes a run.
Change of plan. Back over the wicket and angles in a slower length ball on off, Mahmudullah taps it down to backward point for a run.
Bends his back and digs in another short ball on off, angling away, this time Mahmudullah allows it through to the keeper.
Neesham switches to around the wicket and angles it away from the right-hander, Mahmudullah pushes at it and misses.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Neesham bangs in a short ball on middle, Mahmudullah goes on the back foot and ramps it over the keeper for a boundary. Moves to 96!
Shortish and angling down the leg side, Shakib plays it down off his pads to fine leg and they cross for a run.
Jimmy Neesham comes back into the attack.
Shakib plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total. 10 from the over again. 41 needed off 42 balls.

FOUR! What a shot! Southee alters his length to go short outside off, Shakib latches onto it with all his power, smashes it through extra cover where Guptill misfields and it speeds away to the fence. The required run rate is under 6 now.

Safely in! Yorker, Mahmudullah digs it out on the leg side and Shakib calls him through for a quick run. Southee charges to the ball, scores a direct hit at the striker's end and appeals. It's referred upstairs and Shakib is found safe in the replays.
Appeal for a run out at the striker's end. Referred upstairs...

Southee runs in from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Shakib stays back and brings his bat down so late. Does well to keep it out towards point and takes a single. Southee giggles, Shakib giggles. They both know it was close.
Short and pulled behind square leg for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Mahmudullah plays a back foot punch but finds the point fielder.
Wide! Action replay of the previous delivery. Southee feeling the pressure here.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Mahmudullah allows it through to the keeper.
Goes back to a short ball and punches it wide of the point fielder for a run. 10 from the over, 51 needed off 48 balls. Santner is done for the evening, 10-0-47-0!
Just short of point. A shortish ball on off, Mahmudullah outside edges his attempted square cut and it falls just short of the point fielder.

Not out! Fires in a quicker and flatter ball on middle, Mahmudullah goes back and punches it through mid-wicket. The bowler runs after it and they return for the second run. The throw comes to the bowler's end where the fielder collects it and breaks the stumps. They appeal, it's referred upstairs and the replays show that the dive saves Shakib.
Appeal for a run out, referred upstairs...
Flighted and on middle, softly pushed through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Record partnership for any wicket in ODIs for Bangladesh.
Wide! Tossed up ball outside off, spinning further away, Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Advances down the track, the bowler slows it up in the air and Mahmudullah is deceived in flight. Fails to flick and is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Excellent shot, beautiful placement. A floated full ball on off, Mahmudullah makes some space, goes down on one knee and clobbers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Slower short ball on off, Mahmudullah walks down the track and pulls it firmly to deep mid-wicket for one. 9 from the over.
On a length and around off, Mahmudullah opens the face of the bat late and guides it fine at third man for a couple of runs.
Short again, angling into the batsman, it's been pulled over mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Crunched! A touch short in length around off, angling in, Shakib shimmies down the track and spanks it through covers for a powerful boundary. This is now the highest partnership for Bangladesh in Champions Trophy.
Play and a miss! Southee comes from around the wicket and bowls a speedy short delivery wide outside off, Shakib flashes and misses.
A mistimed pull in the air, goes wide of Guptill at mid-wicket and they cross.
Tim Southee is brought back into the attack. Can he break this partnership and bring New Zealand back in the game? 70 needed from 60 balls.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now five fielders can be placed outside the circle.
Skips down the track to a full ball and pushes it off his pads to mid-wicket. Dot ball to end the over, 6 from the over.
Bowls it with a round-arm action and lands it a touch shorter on off, Shakib cuts it through backward point for two.
Quicker full ball on off, drilled down to long off for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Mahmudullah initially thinks of giving the charge seeing which Santner pulls his length back a bit, lands it around off and the batsman lofts it over extra cover for a couple of runs.
Flighted ball on leg, Shakib sweeps it through square leg for a run.
On a length and around off, some extra bounce, Mahmudullah pushes it with an angled bat to backward point. Tidy over by Milne, 3 from it.
Angles in a full ball on off, Mahmudullah gets forward and pushes it to the off side.
Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah defends it from the crease to the off side.
Milne switches to around the wicket and bangs in a short ball, Shakib pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Fullish and angling into the batsman, Mahmudullah pushes it towards mid on and steals a single.
Wide! Sprays it wide outside off, Mahmudullah runs towards the line of the delivery with no intention of playing at it.
Full in length outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it towards point.
Walks down the track and clips it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Flighted and on middle, Mahmudullah gets behind the line and knocks it down to long on for one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Identical to the last delivery, punched down to long off for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, Mahmudullah punches from the crease to covers.
Slower delivery around leg, Shakib nudges it wide of short fine leg for a run.
Width on offer outside off, Shakib helps it to third man for a run. 150-run partnership comes up.
On a length around off, angling in, Mahmudullah pushes it gently through covers and rotates the strike. This is now the highest fifth wicket stand for Bangladesh in ODIs.
Wide! Milne takes the pace off the delivery and slips it down the leg side. Mahmudullah fails to flick.
Just over point! Short in length and outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it just over point for a couple of runs.
Jaffa! Beautiful comeback for Milne. Gets a good length ball to jag back in sharply. Cuts Mahmudullah into half as he tries to defend. Beats the inside edge and it's a good take by Ronchi.
FOUR! Edgy! Milne digs in another short ball on off, Mahmudullah top edges his attempted pull shot over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Short of a length ball on middle, Shakib pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Adam Milne is back into the attack. New Zealand desperately need a wicket now.

Spin and bounce around off, Mahmudullah gets back and pushes it to the off side. The cover fielder quickly gets across to the ball and they abort the single. 93 needed from 84 balls. This game is heading towards a cracking finish.
Loopy and full on middle, Shakib forces it down to long on and takes a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Shakib plays a late cut through backward point for a couple of runs.
Tries to sweep but fails to connect. Seems Shakib is tiring.
Flatter ball around leg, a touch shorter in length, Shakib swings his bat but mistimes his shot towards mid-wicket.
Too full in length on the leg stump line, Mahmudullah makes room and drives it through covers for one.

Direct hit would have been interesting. Mahmudullah taps it down to covers and calls his partner through for a quick single. Broom charges towards the ball, dives forward and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Too full and around leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Stays back and cuts it through point. It races through and the third man fielder cuts it off. A couple taken.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Shakib fails to flick.
Slower length ball, following the batsman, Shakib makes room but pulls it straight to mid on.
Follows the shorter one with a fuller delivery on off, Mahmudullah drives it to mid off for a run.
Boult runs in from around the wicket and bangs in a short ball, Mahmudullah ducks.
Short and on off, Mahmudullah goes deep inside the crease and cuts it through point for a run. A couple of tidy overs for the Kiwis after the 13-run over.
Flatter ball on off, Shakib taps it down to covers for a run.
This time Mahmudullah connects with his cover drive and sends it to the deep for a single.
Loopy and outside off, spinning away with extra bounce, Mahmudullah tries to drive through covers but misses.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler.
Extra slower through the air, full and on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to covers and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Mitchell Santner comes back into the attack.
Great yorker, right in the blockhole, Shakib does well to dig it out to the off side. Just 2 from the over.
Too full in length and angling down the leg side, Shakib tries to flick but misses.
Fuller and on off, Mahmudullah eases it to mid off and scampers across to the other end. The fielder is at the edge of the circle and is late in releasing the ball.
Changes his angle for the right-hander. Comes from around the wicket and angles in a slower full ball on off, Mahmudullah plays a mistimed shot to short cover.
Shortish length delivery outside off, Shakib runs it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Shakib plays it softly to mid-wicket and Mahmudullah comes down the track in search of a run. He is sent back.
Shortish outside off, cut through point for one. 13 from the over!
FOUR! Boom! Williamson dishes out a low full toss on off, Shakib charges down the track and hammers it straight down the ground for a boundary. Bangladesh on the charge!
Too full in length on off, driven past the diving cover fielder for a run.
SIX! Mahmudullah gives the charge, reaches to the pitch of the ball and smokes it over cow corner for a biggie.
Pulls his length back a bit and lands it outside off, Shakib camps back and cuts it through point for a run.
A nicely tossed up ball on off, Shakib gets down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.

Time for drinks. Bangladesh have fought their way back into the game with this partnership between Shakib Al Hasan and Mahmudullah. New Zealand are in desperate need of a breakthrough here. Bangladesh need 121 from 114 balls.
18th ODI fifty for Mahmudullah.
Half century for Mahmudullah. He has played a big role in this partnership. Room on offer outside off, Mahmudullah eases it down to third man for a couple of runs. Great recovery from Bangladesh.
Darts in a short ball on off, Shakib pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Not in much control of the shot.
A low full toss on off, Shakib keeps it out on the leg side and finds short mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, Mahmudullah drives it through cover-point for a single.
Short and outside off, Shakib cuts it to point where the fielder fumbles and concedes a single.
Pushed to the cover-point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Trent Boult is brought back into the attack.

Fuller on off, Shakib hangs back and strokes it through extra cover for a couple of runs. Wants the third run but his partner is not interested and he sprints back. Nearly a big mix-up but luckily for Bangladesh no harm done.
Shakib Al Hasan struggling with his left hand. Maybe, some cramps. Physio comes out. Slight halt in play, giving New Zealand time to regroup and rethink their strategies.
Helps it with the spin to square leg for one.
Gets forward and drives it through mid off for a run.
Flighted and outside off, Shakib tries to play the slog sweep but misses. Some turn on display for Williamson.
Flatter and shorter again, punched to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Shortish and on off, cut straight to point.
Kane Williamson brings himself on to bowl.
35th ODI fifty for Shakib Al Hasan. 100-run stand between Shakib Al Hasan and Mahmudullah.

Fifty for Shakib, what a responsible knock by the experienced campaigner. He has brought Bangladesh on track here along with Mahmudullah. This stand needs to continue as far as the Bangla Tigers are concerned. Width on offer outside off, Shakib runs it down to third man for a run. Fine innings under pressure.
Mahmudullah opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slower and fuller on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to mid off.
Wide called for height. Milne bangs in a short ball and gets a tennis ball bounce. It goes way over the head of the batsman.
Back of a length delivery outside off, hitting the deck hard, Mahmudullah taps it down to point.
Milne delivers it around off and falls in his followthrough, Mahmudullah plays it from the crease on the leg side.
Goes back and calmly plays it in front of square leg for a run.
Plays with the spin and turns it towards square leg for a run. Big applause from the crowd, they thought Shakib has reached his fifty. But he is on 49!
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Five wides! Bonus runs for Bangladesh and the momentum has surely shifted. Full and fired down the leg side, Mahmudullah failed to flick and the keeper also failed to collect to his left. It raced away behind for a boundary.
Uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and pushes it towards covers.
Kane Williamson is warming up.
Walks down the track and drives it through mid off for one.
Flatter and shorter on off, Mahmudullah stays back and punches it down to long off for a run.

Helps it off his pads to deep mid-wicket and takes a single. Wants the second run but is sent back. The throw comes to the bowler who fails to collect it and once again Mahmudullah looks for a run only to be sent back again.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Handsome boundary! Full in length and outside off, Mahmudullah strides forward and caresses his drive right through the gap between short extra cover and diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Mahmudullah has slashed hard through the point region. They manage to come back for the second.
Short and pulled in front of square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, it's driven through covers for a single.
Adam Milne is back on. A slip in place.
Santner tosses it up on the stumps, Shakib comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Comes down the track and drives it to mid on for a run.
Quicker on the stumps, Mahmudullah pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman drives it back to the bowler.
Bowls it full on the pads, Shakib sweeps it uppishly down to square leg for a run.
Short outside off, Mahmudullah goes to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
Hurls it on a length on middle, the batsman tucks it on the leg side.
Lands it on a length, Mahmudullah punches it off the back foot to covers.
Length ball outside off, Shakib goes for a drive but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Short ball, Shakib pulls it along the ground to the mid-wicket fence. These two are ticking along well here.
Length ball outside off, Hasan cuts it to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darts it on leg stump, gets a little turn. The batsman goes to flick it off the back foot but gets a leading edge and it rolls on the off side
Flighted delivery outside off, Mahmudullah gets across the stumps to play the paddle shot but it takes the top edge and hits his helmet before rolling towards short third man.
Darts it on the middle stump, Mahmudullah flicks it to square leg.
Slower through the air on the pads, the batsman flicks it on the leg side.
Bowls it on the pads, Shakib flicks it to square leg for a run.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.
Length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah slashes it through point for one.
Switches to over the wicket and delivers a good length ball outside off, Shakib stays back and steers it through cover-point for a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away to backward square leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Anderson runs in from around the wicket and bangs in a short ball around middle and leg, Mahmudullah plays an uncontrolled pull shot but still it comes from the middle of the bat and races away to the fine leg fence.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib slaps it past the diving backward point fielder for a run.
Sees the charge from the batsman bowls it around leg, Shakib turns it around the corner and takes one.
Bowls this with a quicker-arm action, around off, Mahmudullah goes back and forces it to mid on for one.
Goes on the back foot and punches it straight back to the bowler.
Fires it full and on the pads, Shakib sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Slower through the air this time, outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it gently to the off side and takes a run.
Arm ball on off, a touch on the shorter side, Mahmudullah punches it from the crease to the off side. Santner moves across to his right to stop the ball.
Up and over! Width on offer outside off, Shakib stays back and chips it over the point fielder for a couple.
Works it down towards deep backward square leg and returns for the second run.
Nearly edges it! Some extra bounce on this occasion, landing on a good length outside off, Shakib tries hitting square of the wicket on the off side but is beaten.
A touch short and on off, Shakib plays a half-pull across the line but fails to beat Broom at mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Mahmudullah plays it through point for a single.
Good length ball on middle, no real movement, Mahmudullah gets behind the line and pushes it back.
Corey Anderson to have a go now.
Turns it on the leg side but finds the square leg fielder. 3 from the over.
This one is flatter and shorter outside off, Shakib rocks back and cuts it behind point for a couple of runs.
Loopy and around leg, Shakib tries to flick but misses.
Flicks it off his pads to mid-wicket where Guptill makes a good stop.
Follows the batsman down the leg side with a fuller length ball, Shakib drives it straight back and Santner makes a diving stop to his left.
Flighted and full on middle, worked towards square leg for a run. 50-run stand comes up.
Mitchell Santner comes into the attack.
Shortish on middle, Mahmudullah goes on his toes and tucks it off his hips to square leg for one.
Short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. Straight to backward point.
Wide called for height. A bouncer going well over the head of the batsman.
FOUR! Mahmudullah is targeting Neesham here. Receives another short ball in his half, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it disdainfully over square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Clean hit! Neesham delivers a back of a length ball in the line of the stumps, Mahmudullah gives the charge and hammers it over square leg for a biggie.
Shortish this time, angling away from the batsman, Shakib goes for the square cut but gets it away from the outer half of the bat. It goes past gully to third man for a run.
Length ball angling away from the batsman, Shakib pushes it down the ground but finds mid off.
Shakib plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! An overpitched ball outside off, Shakib gives it the full whack of his bat and drills it down the ground to long off for a boundary.
Fractionally short and on middle, sharp in pace, Shakib stands back and plays it down towards gully.
Fuller and straighter, quietly nudged through mid-wicket for a run. Mahmudullah wanted the second run but his partner was not interested.
Back of a length ball on off, defended to the off side.
On a length and just outside off, Mahmudullah stays back and taps it down in front of the gully fielder.
Short delivery, on middle this time, Shakib pulls it past the mid-wicket fielder and it's cut off in the deep. A couple of runs taken.
Jumping onto the batsman, Mahmudullah goes on his toes and taps it down to square leg for a single.
Fullish and on off, Mahmudullah drives it off the front foot to mid off.
Play and a miss! Neesham digs in a short ball on off, Mahmudullah tries to pull but misses. Stares exchanged.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven down the ground but straight to mid off.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Mahmudullah gets forward and defends it back.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Milne sends across a short of a length ball outside off, Shakib rides the bounce and nails his pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Fuller in length and on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Straighter in line, Shakib plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Hits the deck hard and bowls a shortish ball on off, Mahmudullah guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Good timing and it just races through. A fuller length ball around off, Shakib presses forward and drills it through extra cover. The mid off fielder runs behind it but fails to pull it back.
Good length ball closer to the off stump line, Shakib plays from the crease to point.
This time Shakib connects with the square cut but finds the point fielder.
Play and a miss! A touch short in length and outside off, Shakib tries to play the square cut but bounces a tad high and beats the outside edge.
Taps it down to cover-point and crosses for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Shakib pulls it behind square leg and gets a single.
Jimmy Neesham is introduced into the attack.

Drinks break. Brilliant beginning for New Zealand in this run chase. They have removed the cream of Bangladesh's batting in a jiffy and are bossing the game. The Asian team needs partnerships to claw their way back in this match.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah drives it past the right of the mid off fielder for a couple of runs.

Play and a miss! Short in length and around off, an audacious effort by Mahmudullah as he attempts to run it down to third man with a couple of slips in place. Fails to connect and it goes perilously close past his gloves.

Direct hit would have been curtains for Shakib! Full in length and outside off, Shakib pushes it to mid off and calls his partner for a quick single. Williamson has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Fuller length ball on off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Shakib has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length ball on off, Shakib tries to dab on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Sign of aggression from Mahmudullah. This one is pitched on a length, just a little bit of width on offer, Mahmudullah swings it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller again, on off, Mahmudullah gets behind the line and pushes it to the off side. Not in the gap.
Drops it on a fuller length on off, slower in pace probably, Shakib plays at it with soft hands and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Pitches it up this time, just outside off, Shakib drives it off the front foot to mid off.
FOUR! Nicely done this time! Southee digs in a short ball on off, Shakib gets enough time to go back and pack a punch through covers for a cracking boundary.
Play and a miss! Southee runs in and delivers a slightly short of a length ball outside off, Shakib tries to cut but misses.
Stays back and pushes it through the gap at covers for a couple of runs.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Mahmudullah is in next.

OUT! Sound of timber! Take that for a reply from the fast bowler. Brilliant delivery, on a length around off and jags back in sharply at 146 kph to breach Rahim's defense. He stays put to block but is beaten for pace and movement. Goes through the big gap between his bat and pad to shatter the stumps. Big blow to Bangladesh and they are staring down the barrel.

FOUR! Not in control of the shot! Milne bangs in a short ball, Rahim opts for the pull shot over the leg side but fails to get it away from the middle of the bat. It flies over the bowler's head and races away to the fence.
Shortish and outside off, Rahim cuts but finds the point fielder.
Starts with a length ball around leg, Shakib fails to connect with his flick shot and it goes off his pads to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Adam Milne is the first bowling change. A slip and gully in place...
Good length ball on off, Rahim plays with a loose bottom hand to point.
Back of a length ball on off, Rahim gets on top of the bounce and steers it through backward point for a couple of runs.
Spears in a full ball on middle, Rahim gets forward and across to flick but it takes the leading edge and rolls to covers.
Bouncer, on middle, Rahim ducks. Called a wide for height!
On the pads, eased behind square leg but straight to the fielder.
Very full in length on off, Shakib bunts it out in front of mid off and calls his partner for a quick single. Rahim is late in taking off but makes it safely to the other end.
Shortish and on off, Shakib stays back and taps it down to gully.
Powerplay 2 is upon us. Maximum of 4 fielders allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A bouncer in the line of the stumps, Rahim sways away to complete the over, a probing one.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Bouncer this time, to force the batsman deep inside the crease, Rahim ducks.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Almost identical to the last delivery, this time Rahim plays closer to his body and pushes it with an angled bat to point.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Poor from Ross Taylor, should have gone with both hands. A length ball angling away from the batsman, Rahim pushes inside the line, there is some extra bounce and it catches the outside edge. Taylor standing at wide first slip dives to his left but fails to hold on to the catch. It deflects off his left palm and races away to the fence.
Good length ball on middle, turned towards square leg for a run.
Follows the batsman down the leg side, Rahim tries making room for his shot but only manages to push it towards mid on.
Beaten! Bowls it with a scrambled seam this time, on a length and outside off, Rahim pushes at it but it moves away to beat the outside edge.
Southee digs in a short ball on off, Shakib tries to ramp it but gets it away from the toe end of the bat. It flies past the jumping gully fielder, Guptill to third man. A single taken.
Pitches it full again, around off, this time Shakib waits for it and drives it towards cover-point. Good timing but not in the gap.
Beaten all ends up! Fuller length ball on off, leaving the left-hander, Shakib tries to drive without any footwork and misses.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib cuts it behind point for a run.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Shakib presses forward in defense.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Bangs it short on middle, Rahim fails to control his pull shot but gets it away safely to fine leg for a single.
Shaping back into the batsman, Rahim defends it from the crease.
Wide! Inswinger but down the leg side, Rahim fails to flick it off his pads.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A leg gully and forward short leg in place. Only one slip in place.
Angling away from the left-hander, Shakib draws forward, feels for it and gets beaten.
Too full in length on middle, Rahim works it off the inner half of the bat to fine leg for a single.
Angles in a length delivery around middle, some extra bounce, Rahim fails to keep it out and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller in length angling into the batsman, Rahim tries flicking but it takes the leading edge and rolls to mid off.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Three slips in place now.
Boult changes his angle and runs in from around the wicket, it's bowled wide outside off, Rahim pushes at it and chips it in the air over point. A single taken. Another testing over.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim cuts it firmly through the line but finds point.
Uppish but safe! A snorter by Boult, bangs it short and well-directed, Rahim tries to fend at it but it takes the outer half of the bat and lobs in the air. A silly point would have been handy there.
Angling away from the batsman, short in length, Rahim drops his wrists and allows it through.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.
Wide! Back of a length delivery going down the leg side, Rahim tries to glance but misses. That was not far away from his gloves.

Shout for an lbw! Boult is proving too hot to handle. Delivers a swinging delivery, Rahim tries to flick but misses. Takes a blow on the front pad, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Maybe, pitching outside leg.

Shout for an lbw! Full and swinging down the leg side, Shakib fails to flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal vociferously but the umpire shakes his head. Exceptional over by Southee, a wicket maiden.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shakib Al Hasan is in next.

OUT! End of a nervy stay for Soumya Sarkar! Tim Southee is on fire, hunts down his third victim. He hurls across a length ball around middle and it shapes back in after pitching. Sarkar sticks back to play it out but misses and is rapped on the back leg. They appeal, it looks high but umpire Ian Gould raises his finger. Southee is delighted. This is the best possible start for the Kiwis. Top three Bangla batsmen back in the hut. The replays show it was high, so Soumya will be disappointed at the moment.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Beautifully bowled delivery. An outswinger around off, the line forced the batsman to play at it, Sarkar ends up pushing inside the line and missing.
Good length ball angling away from the batsman, Sarkar punches it from the crease to covers.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Width on offer outside off, Soumya guides it down to third man for one.
Sharp delivery, short and going down the leg side, Sarkar tries to glance but fails to connect. It goes off his gloves but doesn't carry to the keeper.
Shortish on off, Sarkar gets back and punches it to point.

Not out! Good length ball outside off, bouncing a tad high, Sarkar pokes at it and edges it behind. Seeing that the catch will not carry to first slip, Guptill dives full length to his right and takes a low catch. He is not sure whether it carried or not and hence the umpires go upstairs. Soft signal is not out. The replay confirms that it has bounced before going into his hands.
Edged and Guptill has dived to his right from second slip to take a low catch. But he is not sure, whether it carried to him. The umpires go upstairs to check. Soft signal is not out.
Beauty! This is a magnificent spell of seam bowling from both ends. Boult lets out a cracker, on a length and around off, Sarkar is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
Good length and around off, shaping away a bit, Rahim defends it to end a superb over.
Wide! This one is too wide outside off, Rahim allows it through.

This is a wonderful spell from Southee. He uses the crease and goes wide of it at the time of delivery. Serves it on a back of a length around off, Rahim has to play at it but it moves away to beat the outside edge.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Birthday boy, Mushfiqur Rahim walks in next.

OUT! Peach of a delivery and Southee has his second wicket. Outstanding bowling, unplayable for any batsman. The line is so good that Sabbir has to play at it. It's around off, Rahman tries to defend by getting forward but it straightens a touch to take the outside edge. Ronchi makes no mistake, they appeal and the finger is up. Bangladesh in early trouble.
Swinging back into the batsman from around off, Sarkar gets forward and pushes it from the inner half of the bat to mid on for a run.
A touch short in length on middle, Sarkar plays it down to mid on.
Great fielding, Broom! Width on offer outside off, Rahman plays a cracking square drive and Broom dives full length to his right from backward point to stop the ball.
That's a lethal delivery! Extra bounce from a length around off, Rahman gets back to keep it out but is hit on the gloves.
Good length ball around leg, Sabbir fails to work it on the leg side and takes a blow high on his pads.
Back of a length ball on off, Rahman stays back and plays it down to to the off side.
Too straight on this occasion, Sarkar tickles it in the gap on the leg side for a single. Gets off the mark.
That's a jaffa to begin! Boult hurls it on a good length around off, drifting in and holding its line after landing, Sarkar pushes at it without much intent and gets beaten.
Trent Boult with will bowl with second new ball.
Bangs it short on the stumps, Sabbir ducks under it.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Sabbir lets it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Full ball outside off, Sabbir drives it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! He is underway. Southee bowls it on the pads, Sabbir tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.

OUT! What a start for New Zealand. They get their first wicket and it's a big one, the in-form batsman Tamim Iqbal goes. Southee bowls it full and around middle, it swings back in as Tamim goes for the flick by getting forward and across. He misses and is struck on the pads. They all go up and the umpire gives it out. Tamim reviews immediately. They go upstairs to check. The replays show that the ball is pitching in line, strikes him in line and is hitting the top of leg stump. New Zealand are all pumped up.
Tamim Iqbal has been given out LBW. He decides to review.
Bowls in on a length, swingning into the pads, Tamim tucks it to square leg.
Tim Southee will bowl with the first new ball. He has one slip in place.
Welcome back for the chase. The umpires and players are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar are the two opening batsmen for Bangladesh.
